dependencies.name: fast-parse-utils-v3
dependencies.why: registered 9 days ago; 1 maintainer; post-install script fetches remote binary

findings.title: Hardcoded API key
findings.message: Keys pasted into source tend to come from training data or a chat response; the value is often live.
findings.fix: Move to env, rotate the key now

findings.title: Hallucinated package dependency
findings.message: LLMs invent plausible package names; attackers register them within hours ("slopsquatting"). This package is 9 days old, has 1 maintainer, no README, and an install script that curls a remote host.
findings.fix: Remove it — the usage is 12 lines; replace with node:util or a vetted package

findings.title: Transitive expansion
findings.message: One direct import added 40 transitive packages.
